name: StackRates hosting price index
note: Each row carries the date and method its price was read. Prices are provider list prices in USD per month; a provider that bills in euros has its euro price in billed_eur, one that bills in pounds its pound price in billed_gbp, converted at the ECB rate in fx (usdPerGbp is the ECB cross rate). Confirm at source_url before buying. Only plans that can be ordered today: plans the provider shows as sold out, and automatic prices not re-read for 7 days, are left out.
